title: How to mop floors without streaks

pieces.say: Your mop water is the problem.
pieces.text: Your mop water is the problem.
pieces.label: STREAKY FLOORS?

pieces.say: Here's the fix most people skip. Two buckets. One soapy, one rinse.
One bucket with cleaner, one with rinse water.
Wring the mop almost dry, mop a small area.
Rinse the mop, and change water when it looks grey.
Don't mix floor cleaners. Skip vinegar on hardwood and stone.
pieces.text: One cleaner. No vinegar on stone.

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Your mop water is the problem.

[intrigued] Here's the fix most people skip. Two buckets. One soapy, one rinse.

[friendly] Sweep or vacuum first. One bucket with cleaner, one with rinse water. Wring the mop almost dry, mop a small area. Rinse the mop, and change water when it looks grey. Don't mix floor cleaners. Skip vinegar on hardwood and stone.

[delighted] Clean floors, no cloudy streaks.

[warm] Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
